name: Yatsumiya Aki
source:
The protagonist’s birth mother, a calm, beautiful woman who looks wonderful in a kimono—
She may seem like that, but she’s actually quite a klutz—a sweet, absent-minded mom.
She falls over whenever she gets flustered, making her kimono ride up and often flashing her bottom.
And she’s quite something with her clothes off, too—a mom with a curvy, hourglass figure.
The daughter of an old-established family, she eloped with the protagonist’s father to marry him, but was taken back by her family after giving birth to the protagonist.
Aki had long wanted to see her son, and now that her father has passed away, she’s finally free. Ever since she came straight to the Sakurazaka household, she’s been doting on her son nonstop.
Having been raised as a young lady, she’s hardly ever done housework, but she tries her best to do chores for her son as a maid.
However, she doesn’t know some things that most people would consider common sense, and she sometimes makes unbelievable mistakes.

[Translated from [url=https://www.digiket.com/work/show/_data/ID=ITM0041433/]Digiket[/url]]
